item.title: My Brief Germany: Wednesday, October 28
item.description: Good morning, and welcome to your Germany brief. The coalition is under pressure. A minister from the junior partner resigned this month, Chancellor Merz's approval ratings are weak, and the far-right AfD keeps gaining after strong results in the September regional elections. item.title: My Brief: Wednesday, October 28
item.description: Good morning, and welcome to your Wednesday brief. Here is what matters today, from Egypt, Bayern, Germany, and the global markets. First, Egypt. The pound has hit a fresh record low. On Monday it weakened past fifty-six to the dollar for the first time, after touching about fifty-five on Thursday last week. item.title: Test episode: your new voice
item.description: Good morning, and welcome to your Sunday brief. This is a quick test, so you can hear how I sound before we switch the real briefs over. Bayern had a solid week, markets were a little nervous, and back home in Cairo the weather is finally cooling down. If this sounds like you, we're in business. If not, tell me what feels off, and I'll tune it.
